comment: Pinned shader toolchain for spec 008 (task T-023). An unpinned toolchain makes 'it compiled yesterday' meaningless, so every field here is recorded and verified before a compile run.

spirv.reason: Tint/Dawn consume SPIR-V 1.4-era modules; vulkan1.1 is the environment DXC produced in the verified runs

gaps.why: no Tint/Dawn binary is available in this environment, so SPIR-V -> WGSL translation and WGSL validation cannot run; recorded as a gap in evidence/implementation.md rather than assumed
cross-backend constant-offset comparison needs a SPIR-V disassembler; the DXIL side is checked by reflect.ps1 and the SPIR-V side is compile-only until a disassembler is pinned
